working_title_v3: Resilience-Aware Service Continuity in Heterogeneous 6G Networks: Cross-Layer Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Devices
scientific_problem: How to preserve minimum useful service for resource-constrained devices when access, compute placement, fidelity, and recovery must be chosen jointly under terrestrial/NTN/backhaul disruption.
why_communications_engineering: The object is wireless service continuity under heterogeneous 6G-era access (TN/NTN, blockage, outage), not an OS or game product dissertation. CWC Wireless Connectivity / Radio Technologies and 6G Flagship SRAs are the public fit; no affiliation is claimed.
proposed_contribution_novelty_hypothesis: A service-continuity formulation that treats minimum useful service as a cross-layer objective and evaluates access, compute placement, fidelity/recovery actions, and TN/NTN fallback through a reproducible instrumented stack. The novelty claim remains to be tested against the focused literature review and supervisor/peer-review feedback. Not a claim of established novelty, new PHY, operator NTN performance, or trained RL.
what_is_measurable: Continuity states; task_completion_ratio + time_above_minimum_useful with 95% t-CI (RQ1); service_continuity_utility, fidelity/checkpoint costs, thrash, switch/compute cost with CIs (RQ2); NTN vs terrestrial uptime/min_service/recovery with paired defs and decision regions (RQ3); host process timing (not sub-ms edge proof).
baselines: SpectrumX: no_adaptation / static / placement-only / fixed_target_fidelity / checkpoint_disabled. ReadyGary: exhaustive/hierarchical/oracle. NTN: terrestrial_baseline / static_ntn / fallback / adaptive. 7GC: proportional-fair stub + seeded profile bench (n=30).
completable_in_simulation: RQ1 seeded profiles + task-completion/time-above-min-useful with 95% Student-t CIs (n=30); RQ2 Paper II packs + fidelity/checkpoint actions + runtime information-equivalence; RQ3 TN/NTN seeded decision regions with CIs (n=30); SYNTHETIC_SIM throughout.

validation_that_would_materially_strengt: a test-network or measurement transfer campaign for RQ3 (high-value later validation, not a stated CWC defence requirement)
physical_optional_vs_thesis_critical.reason: The V3 plan is structured as a four-year, simulation-first and measurement-grounded programme. Later measurement/test-network access strengthens Papers II-III but does not gate the theoretical core. Hardware shipping is product, not the dissertation object.

research_instruments.spectrumx-ai-ran-gary: AI-RAN / cross-layer policy instrument + competition IQ core

evidence_now.digital: Post-A2 accepted-main digital strong core: 7GC #31 statistical parity; SpectrumX #102 fidelity+checkpoint+info-equivalence; NTN #28 statistical parity. Faculty paths re-run 2026-08-28 on detached origin/main. Not physical/independent validation; dissertation not complete.

what_oulu_cwc_test_network_resources_cou: Sim→measurement transfer for RQ3; independently witnessed RF/QoS; NTN-capable terrestrial fallback on real bearers; external reproduction culture; supervisor narrowing of doctoral scope. Resource-fit only; not uniqueness or affiliation.
